subject: Demo-day preparation
body:
2026-09-01T09:05:00+02:00 — Jule Hartmann: Sandra, what is the programme actually for? A visitor can't infer a project from a title like Beyond Tomorrow.
2026-09-01T09:05:58+02:00 — Sandra Kowalski: Thomas wants one sentence per team explaining what the audience will see. Nora is adding that column today.
2026-09-01T09:07:05+02:00 — Jule Hartmann: Good. Then I can give the cover less space. We don't need a slogan competing with the students' work.
2026-09-01T09:08:23+02:00 — Sandra Kowalski: Keep the practical demo instructions separate. Teachers need equipment notes; visitors don't need a printed cable inventory.
2026-09-01T09:09:46+02:00 — Jule Hartmann: I'll make a proof with obvious empty boxes where descriptions are missing. Otherwise everybody assumes the layout is finished.
2026-09-01T09:10:50+02:00 — Sandra Kowalski: Do that. Felix can chase the teams, and we'll answer the assessment-order question before he replies to the group.
